root_idea.summary: An orientation toward the beauty of a thing and making it beautiful; zayn is opposed to shayn, ugliness or defect.
root_idea.development: The root extends from beauty and beautification to adornment as an external means or result, attractive presentation or commendation, worldly display, and becoming adorned. These developments belong to particular derived forms and are not interchangeable in every usage.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Distinct Quran-attested Form V verb with an inchoative usage.

senses.definition: To adorn, beautify, decorate, or make the beauty of something apparent.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for visible or perceptible beautification of things, places, qualities, or circumstances. The Quran uses both active and passive constructions; the agent may be stated or left unspecified.

senses.definition: To make something seem attractive, good, or commendable to someone; to commend or present it favorably.
senses.usage_conditions: Often constructed with لِ and an intended perceiver. The object may be a deed, desire, belief, or other matter, including something morally bad; the agent may be God, Satan, people, or unspecified.

senses.definition: To become adorned or beautified; to come into a visibly attractive state.
senses.usage_conditions: An intransitive or quasi-reflexive use. In its Quranic occurrence it describes the earth becoming adorned with vegetation.

senses.definition: Adornment, ornament, or embellishment: something by which a person, thing, place, or scene is made attractive.
senses.usage_conditions: May refer to ornaments, clothing, bodily or natural beauty, and valued worldly display such as wealth and children. Quranic contexts include the adornment of the earth, the heavens, people, and worldly life.

senses.definition: In the expression يَوْمُ الزِّينَةِ, a festival or holiday, literally a day of adornment.
senses.usage_conditions: A conventional expression for a festal day on which people adorn themselves and appear in good clothing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To adorn or grace a person or thing; by extension, to be an honor or credit, to embellish speech or an action, or to present a commodity favorably.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The commercial use refers to setting off a commodity without concealing a defect or lying in its description.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To adorn oneself or assume adornment; of language or an action, to be dressed up, embellished, or presented attractively to another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reflexive use may also mean investing oneself with something that does not properly belong to oneself, as in assuming a false adornment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Grace, comeliness, beauty, or a creditable quality; anything that is a person's or thing's pride or glory.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May describe physical or intellectual adornment and may function adjectivally in expressions contrasting comeliness with ugliness.
A separate concrete lexical use of the noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Beautiful or comely, as in the expression “a beautiful moon.”
The art or occupation of a مُزَيِّن, especially the work of a barber or beautifier.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A professional or occupational noun in later usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a man: having the hair trimmed, clipped, or shaved.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized application referring to grooming by a barber.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cupper; by common extension, a barber or person who grooms and beautifies others.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word can retain the older association with cupping while commonly denoting a barber.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Adorned, ornamented, beautified, or self-adorned; graced by something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Participial forms describe a person or thing possessing adornment or appearing graced by an external quality.

cautions: The Form V Quranic occurrence is an intransitive or quasi-reflexive use meaning ‘become adorned’; it should not be treated as identical in construction to the transitive Form II verb.
زِينَةٌ ranges from concrete ornaments and natural beauty to valued worldly display; the immediate object and construction determine the intended nuance.
